title: US proposes ending 60-day grace period for H-1B workers after job loss
content: A US government proposal could eliminate the current 60-day grace period for H-1B visa holders. Affected workers might need to depart the United States immediately after job termination. They generally cannot change immigration status or employers within the country. This rule change applies to several temporary worker visa categories and their dependents. The proposal is currently under federal review and public comment.

title: After Germany’s exit, India eyes France-led sixth-generation fighter programme

India's own fifth-generation fighter is also expected to fly around 2028. This collaboration aligns with India-France's strategic defense partnership goals. The joint effort aims to advance both nations' aerial combat capabilities.

title: Michael Dell’s son’s startup offers $695 alternative to costly home generators

This startup is valued at thirteen billion dollars after significant funding.

title: Kansas bans student phones, earbuds and smartwatches for entire school day

Schools are now reviewing technology policies and limiting device usage during non-instructional periods.

The company is committed to advancing its AI infrastructure to pave the way for future innovations and anticipates a reduced headcount due to the layoffs.
